title: Hachimitsu MIDI Player for MC
description: This is a minecraft port of "Hachimitsu MIDI Player" that I am developing.
body:
# Hachimitsu MIDI Player for Minecraft (from c ported)

**This is still in development so there will be many glitches!**

## What's this?
This is a MIDIPlayer, yes, it is definitely a MIDIPlayer.
MIDIPlayer ported from C code.

## What features does it include?
- MIDI player  \
  MIDI playback (/midi load <MIDI Path>)  \
  MIDI stop function (/midi stop)  \
  MIDI pause and play function (default p key)  \
  File selection dialog (default l key)  \
- Extended note block  \
  This contains 0-127 piano sounds. , It's too much to go to a specific scale lol  \
  (We plan to add a dialog that allows you to specify the scale in the future.)

...for now it only has piano and drums (it's a pain to put a bunch of sounds into a sound pack).
